'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Gemme LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Gemme]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-communing-pre.gif|label=Communing}}
* '''Username:''' Mike Gemme
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
